items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Rene, he was real good too.

ctx.x: He was really popular. Yeah, yeah, he was good. Well, what about somebody like Rene? Would he be more popular? Rene, he was real good too.
He was popular too with the people. But would he be more popular in the seventh war than he would in the third?
